name: native collection iterator spread propagates next errors
source: function main():void { const m=new Map<string,number>();m.set("a",1);const a:any=m;const it:any=a.keys();it.next=()=>{throw new Error("next failed");};try {const xs:any=[...it];console.log(xs.length);} catch(e:any){console.log(e.message);} }
